name: drop-text
title: Drop Text
description: Text that drops into place with configurable stagger origins and character, word, or line splitting.

props.name: variant
props.description: Animation style used for the text entrance.

props.name: splitBy
props.description: Text unit used for the drop animation.

props.name: staggerFrom
props.description: Origin used for the staggered drop sequence.

props.name: yOffset
props.description: Starting vertical offset in pixels. Negative values rise from above, positive values drop from below.

props.name: scaleFrom
props.description: Starting scale before the text settles into place.

props.name: startOpacity
props.description: Starting opacity before the text animates in.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between each animated text unit.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used by the drop animation.

props.name: animateOnScroll
props.description: Runs the animation when the component enters the viewport.
